content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after arriving on Item (list) a console error is raised (event 401), and the user clicks the Item 190 row (event 458) which is followed by navigation back to Accounts Receivable (report) (event 460), so the row click appears to return to the report rather than open the item.", "fix": "Fix: On the item:list screen, check the Item 190 row click handler so it opens the item instead of navigating back to the accounts receivable report, and clear the console error raised when item:list loads.", "cited_event_ids": ["391", "401", "458", "460"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The content of the console errors; only the error type is recorded", "Why the Item 190 click returns to the accounts receivable report", "Whether the overlay shown on item:list load blocks interaction", "The median 7.1 s time loss is not attributable to a single event in the windows"]}
